instruction: Enable tap-to-click functionality for the touchpad on my Ubuntu system so I can tap instead of clicking.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tap-to-click for touchpad. Setup disables tap-to-click (false), agent must enable it (true). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'true\n' when enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts tap-to-click setting state using gsettings command
Metric (exact_match) appropriately compares boolean setting output
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct and includes newline as per gsettings output format

State accessibility: gsettings is persistent, no UI/dialog dependency, no postconfig needed
